t: Open-source smart glasses with a tiny display, a camera, and a microphone.
steps: Look for a used Frame from another owner. Brilliant Labs no longer lists it in its store.
Charge the glasses in the charging cradle with a USB-C cable.
Install the Frame Python SDK and read the Frame SDK guide.
Pair the glasses with your computer over Bluetooth.
Run an SDK example that prints text on the display.
Try an example that takes a photo with the camera.
